name: Boxes PRO - OB persistence long
note: Author treats a fast and slow Williams %R both sitting near the top of their range for a couple of bars as confirmed exhaustion strength, firing a BUY box.  SIMPLIFIED: Dropped the EMA smoothing on the fast (7-bar) and slow (3-bar) %R lines; used raw Williams %R instead; Dropped the hysteresis/grace-bar state machine (i_exitHyst, i_graceBars) that can cancel a box before it confirms; approximated as the condition holding for the 2-bar min_box_bars window; Dropped the optional 'Average formula' mode (avg of fast+slow %R) since 'Standard' is the default formula; Dropped the optional EMA trend fi
